project.name: ramzinex-ai-trader
project.purpose: Regime-aware, cost-aware algorithmic crypto trading system for Ramzinex
project.primary_objective: Maximize risk-adjusted expected net return per unit holding time, not raw prediction accuracy.
project.important_disclaimer: No strategy is guaranteed to be profitable. All strategies must pass realistic walk-forward backtests including fees, spread, slippage, latency and execution constraints before live deployment.

design_principles.llm_role: Research, diagnostics, anomaly explanation and optional external-information interpretation; never the direct order trigger.
design_principles.numeric_ai_role: Estimate probabilities, expected returns, volatility and trade quality from structured market features.
design_principles.orchestrator_role: Select or combine strategies according to market regime.
design_principles.risk_role: Have veto power over every trade.
design_principles.execution_role: Optimize limit/market execution and manage live order state.
design_principles.default_mode: Paper trading first, then very small capital, then gradual scaling.

public_endpoints.purpose: Estimate realized buy cost for a quantity
Estimate realized sell proceeds/cost for a quantity

regime_engine.purpose: Detect market state before allowing strategy-specific entry logic.

recommended_method.phase_1: Rule-based regime classifier using volatility, trend strength, price structure and volume.

entry_logic: Expected net edge exceeds trading cost
Extreme deviation from local fair value
Expected net edge exceeds trading cost

orderbook_microstructure.use: Short-horizon confirmation and timing layer, not standalone truth.
orderbook_microstructure.hard_filter: Reject signals when liquidity quality is poor or book conditions are unstable.

breakout_volume.use: Capture expansion after a validated range break.

ai_layer.architecture: Use a supervised tabular model as the first production candidate; use LLMs outside the latency-critical decision loop.
ai_layer.decision_rule: Trade only when expected net return is positive and exceeds a configurable risk/cost buffer.

signal_fusion.architecture: Independent strategy signals feed a meta-decision layer.
signal_fusion.recommended_v1: Weighted fusion plus ML meta-model; regime engine controls which alpha signals are eligible.
signal_fusion.important_rule: Do not require unanimous agreement; require sufficient expected edge after costs and risk constraints.

principles: Risk engine can veto every signal.
Daily and rolling drawdown limits are mandatory.
Circuit breaker after abnormal API, execution or market conditions.

policy.default: Prefer limit execution when expected fill probability is adequate and edge survives waiting.
policy.market_order: Use when immediacy has higher expected value than price improvement.
policy.cancel_replace: Reprice stale limit orders using a bounded policy.

portfolio_engine.phase_1: Single-position or limited concurrent positions to simplify validation.
portfolio_engine.selection_metric: Expected net return per unit time adjusted for correlation and risk.
portfolio_engine.avoid: Blindly trading every pair with a signal.

data_and_storage.minimum_retention: Enough historical data to support multiple market regimes and robust walk-forward validation.
data_and_storage.event_logging: Every decision must be reproducible from stored inputs, model version and configuration.

primary_metrics: Cost as percentage of gross PnL
anti_overfitting: No optimization on the final holdout period
Prefer simple feature sets before adding complexity
Reject strategies whose edge disappears under modest cost/slippage stress

deployment_phases.name: Data warehouse
deployment_phases.goal: Collect OHLCV, orderbook and trades continuously.

deployment_phases.name: Strategy research
deployment_phases.goal: Implement momentum, mean reversion, orderbook and breakout independently.

deployment_phases.name: ML meta-model
deployment_phases.goal: Estimate net edge and trade quality.

deployment_phases.name: Paper trading
deployment_phases.goal: Validate live data, latency, fills and model calibration without real capital.

deployment_phases.name: Small-capital live test
deployment_phases.goal: Validate real execution with tightly bounded risk.

deployment_phases.name: Scale
deployment_phases.goal: Increase capital only after statistically credible live performance.

recommended_default_strategy_stack.ai: LightGBM/XGBoost meta-model estimating expected net return
recommended_default_strategy_stack.risk: Volatility-aware position sizing + hard drawdown/circuit-breaker controls

what_not_to_build_first: Always-on ensemble with no regime detection

before_live: Positive edge after conservative transaction-cost assumptions
Stable performance across multiple market regimes
Live paper-trading behavior matches backtest assumptions
success_gate.production_principle: The bot should trade less when edge is weak and aggressively refuse low-quality opportunities.
